text:
Sam (Support): BrightCo reporting intermittent 503/504s and client timeouts on /v1/generate since 09:10 PST. p95 spiking to ~8-12s, some 5xxs. Example x-request-ids: abc123, def456. Tenant: brightco-prod :rotating_light:
DevOps-Bot: alert: hosted.gateway.queue.depth >= 500 for tenant=brightco-prod (rule: tenant-queue-depth)
Alice (Oncall): looking. Any repro steps / example request body we can use?
Sam (Support): customer sent this curl and a small corpus they say reliably repros on their traffic pattern (long sequences + streaming):
```
curl -i -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"redwood-620B","input":"<~2k tokens payload repeated>","max_tokens":1024}'
```
Sam (Support): They also provided a sample trace: x-request-id=abc123, gateway-ms=9200, backend-ms=8900, grpc-status=14
Priya (SRE): grabbing logs. I see continuous-batcher backlog for tenant brightco-prod. snippets: `queue_depth=512 max_allowed=500 tenant=brightco-prod`, `batcher_backlog_ms=1200`, `dequeue_wait_ms=450`, and repeated `kvcache_miss=true`. That aligns with tail-latency timeouts when long sequences block the batch pipeline.
Jorge (Eng Runtime): thanks Priya. This looks like the tenant is producing many long-seq requests that keep holding the KV cache and batch windows open. Continuous batching learns a larger batch size -> queue drift -> p95 spikes.
Maya (Support): customer says this started after ramping traffic this morning, no code changes on their side besides increasing batch sends.
Ben (BrightCo): confirming, we increased parallelism to speed up throughput. We didn't expect this to produce 503s. Happy to throttle if needed but want minimal functional impact.
Alice (Oncall): immediate mitigation options: 1) apply tenant-level early_reject (reject if queue_depth > 0.75*max) 2) temporarily reduce continuous_batch_window_ms for the tenant to 20ms 3) enable small_batch_size override for brightco-prod. Which we can do now?
Priya (SRE): I can toggle early_reject for tenant in the routing policy (safe, fast), and set batch_window override to 20ms for the tenant. Doing early_reject first since it's lower-risk.
Priya (SRE): action: PATCH /admin/tenants/brightco-prod/policies -> {"early_reject_enabled":true, "early_reject_threshold":0.7} ; pushed at 09:28 PST.
DevOps-Bot: config-update: tenant-policy brightco-prod early_reject=true (change-id: cfg-3312)
Sam (Support): applied and asked customer to retry.
Ben (BrightCo): testing now... first test shows one 503 but next three calls are fine. Collecting more results.
Priya (SRE): still seeing queue depth tail but dropping: queue_depth now peaking ~420. batcher_backlog_ms trending down to ~300ms.
Jorge (Eng Runtime): follow-up: we should also instrument batcher to prefer smaller batches when KV-cache miss ratio high for a tenant. I'll open a patch but that's medium-term.
Jorge (Eng Runtime): quick repro command (internal): `kubectl logs -l service=continuous-batcher -c batcher | grep brightco-prod -A3` — look for `enqueue_time` vs `dequeue_time` deltas.
Maya (Support): customer sent a second curl with streaming and got a 504 with x-request-id=def456. Attached logs show `prefix_kv_miss=true` for that session.
Priya (SRE): kv miss + long request = batch lock. Suggest we also enable tenant-level rate limit burst cap to 100 rps while we stabilize.
Alice (Oncall): go ahead, Priya. I'll coordinate with sales/customer success so BrightCo knows we're throttling temporarily.
Priya (SRE): set tenant rate-limit burst=100, rate=60 rps at 09:36 PST. DevOps-Bot confirms change (cfg-3313).
ops-bot: audit: tenant-rate-limit update brightco-prod (actor=priya)
Ben (BrightCo): thanks — seeing steady success now, p95 ~120ms for short requests, long requests still 1-2s but no 5xx. Appreciate the fast response.
Jorge (Eng Runtime): created eng ticket (JIRA-REDWOOD-1234) to implement per-tenant batch-size heuristic and KV-miss detection to avoid batch growth during high-miss windows. Patch scoped.
Priya (SRE): logs post-mitigation: `queue_depth_max=438`, `batcher_backlog_ms_peak=340`, `5xx_rate 1m=0.2%` down from 4.7%.
Sam (Support): I'll keep customer updated and confirm SLAs. Marking incident as mitigated but not resolved.
Maya (Support): followups: ask BrightCo for a sample production trace (full headers + sample payload) for the 504s so we can replay in staging.
Ben (BrightCo): will share a sanitized trace in #support-private in 30m.
Alice (Oncall): next steps: 1) eng runtime to implement heuristic (JIRA-REDWOOD-1234), 2) SRE to monitor tenant queue metrics for 24h, 3) postmortem write-up if recurrence. Assign Priya/Jorge.
Priya (SRE): acknowledged. I'll collect metrics and write short RCA notes.
Jorge (Eng Runtime): starting a small experiment to lower continuous_batch_window default from 50ms->30ms for tenants flagged with high-kv-miss ratio. Will test in canary.
Sam (Support): closing loop with customer: BrightCo reports no more 5xxs after config changes. Will reopen if they see anything else.
DevOps-Bot: incident-note created: incident/2026-03-18/brightco-batcher-backlog. ticket=JIRA-REDWOOD-1234
Alice (Oncall): great work everyone. We'll reconvene after metrics collection. :thumbsup:
